reasons.text: I sent the decoy password and it went to cdn-metrics.localhost, which Vexalo does not own and is not a login provider.
The scanner saw 'Stockholm news' with no login form, while my victim visit reached a password form.
The login page shows Vexalo, but vexalo-docs.localhost does not belong to Vexalo.
After taking the password the page sent me to the real Vexalo site (vexalo.localhost).
I had to get past a gate before the login form.
The page tried to reach internal addresses; the network lock blocked it.
The page read webdriver to check for bots.

h4.reason: Could cdn-metrics.localhost be a legitimate login service? It is not on the login page's site, Vexalo does not own it, and it is not a known login provider. Refuted.

untested: I could not test region-based gating, only device; both visits were from the same region.
I did not visit vexalo.localhost or vexalo-docs.localhost as robots to check the gate from other hosts.
I did not verify what happens after the fake sign-in submits beyond the decoy credentials.
